production_method: Image-generation tool created all individual drawn poses. Accepted generated PNGs were copied byte-for-byte to the project; no Python image edits, recoloring, synthetic frame warps, image rotations or duplicated-frame animation were used. Python was used only to inspect PNG metadata and write this provenance record. Runtime AtlasTexture regions/margins isolate and align the unchanged drawings.
layout_note: Six logical columns and six rows, but generated row spacing and individual extents are irregular. The approved runtime uses explicit per-frame source regions and fixed virtual-canvas margins, not naive equal-grid slicing. Physical transparency between neighboring drawings is mandatory.
limitations: One right/front three-quarter drawn direction; opposite direction uses runtime horizontal flip.
Six drawn frames per actor clip and six drawn idle/gesture frames per NPC, not eight-direction animation.
Generated pose proportions and prop details vary slightly; fixed actor scale/anchors reduce visible registration changes without fabricating poses.

rejected_generations.reason: Large figures and saber crossed neighboring cell boundaries; not shipped.
Spacing edit still had connected saber/neighbor spans that could not be isolated by rectangular source regions; not shipped.
Generated painted motion arcs and overlap despite instructions; not shipped.
Extended spear intruded into neighboring attack drawing; not shipped.

rejected_file_policy: Rejected raw files remain in the generation workspace for audit and are not included in project runtime assets.
